title: A Cyclic Polytabloid Proof of Saxl's Conjecture

abstractEnglish: For every staircase partition, we prove that the tensor square of the corresponding irreducible complex representation of the symmetric group contains every irreducible representation of that group. This proves Saxl's conjecture.
